name: AxleHire
description: AxleHire was an AI-powered same-day and next-day last-mile delivery platform founded in 2015 in Emeryville, California. Drivers delivered packages for major brands like HelloFresh, American Eagle, and Nespresso with pre-planned routes and guaranteed pay. AxleHire has since rebranded to Jitsu. To sign up as a driver, visit Jitsu at gojitsu.com.
redirectMessage: AxleHire has rebranded to Jitsu. To sign up as a driver, visit Jitsu at gojitsu.com.

name: Jitsu
description: Jitsu (formerly AxleHire) is an AI-powered same-day and next-day last-mile delivery platform founded in 2015 in Emeryville, California. Drivers deliver packages for major brands like HelloFresh, American Eagle, and Nespresso. Routes are pre-planned and scheduled in advance so you know your earnings before you start. SUV and minivan drivers can earn up to $225 per day. A solid option for drivers who prefer structured routes over waiting for on-demand orders.
otherRequirements: Valid driver's license, background check required. Larger vehicles (SUV/minivan) get access to higher-paying routes.
bonusProgram: Opportunities for bonuses based on performance
notes: Formerly AxleHire. Routes are pre-planned with guaranteed pay. Drivers with larger vehicles earn significantly more. Some driver reviews mention long wait times at warehouses and inconsistent route availability.

name: Senpex
description: Senpex is an AI-powered same-day courier platform specializing in B2B and catering deliveries. A significant portion of orders come through corporate catering partnerships like ezCater, which may require setup assistance upon arrival. Drivers earn 85-90% commission per delivery and are paid twice per week. Instant pay is not currently available. A great option for drivers with any size vehicle looking for higher-paying specialized orders beyond standard food delivery.
otherRequirements: Driver's license and vehicle insurance required. Experience in delivery preferred.
notes: Senpex is more B2B focused than consumer platforms like DoorDash. Drivers report inconsistent order volume especially outside California. App support has received mixed reviews. Best for drivers with larger vehicles (vans/trucks) who want specialized or catering deliveries.
keyFeatures: White-glove handling; catering setup; real-time tracking; route management; 85-90% commission.
userFeedback: 3.4 to 3.9 out of 5; Pros: High commission and fast feedback; Cons: Poor driver support, app glitches, and disappearing orders.

name: DeliverThat
description: Catering delivery platform focused on business meals and large orders. Requires larger vehicles and provides scheduled delivery windows.
otherRequirements: Larger vehicles preferred for catering orders.
keyFeatures: Pre-booking orders (day before); 100% tip retention; tiered driver levels.
userFeedback: 3.3 out of 5 (Indeed); Keeps drivers busy; requires upfront payment for bags/MVR.

name: DoorDash
description: Leading food delivery platform connecting restaurants with customers. Flexible scheduling and widespread availability make it one of the most accessible gig opportunities.
otherRequirements: Red Card provided for certain orders
instantPayMethod: DasherDirect card or Fast Pay ($1.99 fee)
keyFeatures: Shop and deliver option; alcohol delivery; toggle filters.
userFeedback: Pros: Simple and easy. Cons: Market saturation in small towns.

name: Uber Eats
description: Food delivery service from Uber. Deliver restaurant orders on your schedule. Can combine with Uber rideshare driving for maximum flexibility.
otherRequirements: Can deliver on foot in some cities
instantPayMethod: Instant Pay to debit card, up to 5x/day

name: Instacart
description: Shop for and deliver groceries from popular stores. Choose between full-service shopping or delivery-only batches. Flexible hours and competitive pay.
otherRequirements: Ability to lift 50+ lbs, smartphone with data plan
instantPayMethod: Instant Cashout via Stripe ($0.50 fee, $5 min)
keyFeatures: Grocery shop and delivery; batch orders.
userFeedback: Pros: Good for those who prefer shopping. Cons: Honeymoon period for new hires followed by lower pay.

name: Expedite
description: Expedite (formerly Dlvrd) is a catering delivery and specialty logistics platform operating in 180 markets across the U.S. and Canada. Drivers earn $20-$60 per order with an average of $40-$50/hr. Features Emerald Elite tiers, corporate tip transparency, and the ability to stack orders. Same-day pay available via Everee.
equipmentNeeded: larger vehicles preferred for catering orders
otherRequirements: Pass quick screening via Gigee platform. Professional appearance recommended.
keyFeatures: Emerald Elite tiers; corporate tip transparency; stacking orders; catering bag requirement tracking. Same-day pay via Everee.
userFeedback: 2.3 to 3.3 out of 5; Highly favorable for per-order earnings; some complaints about low order frequency and app notification issues.

name: Zifty
description: Zifty offers scheduled catering delivery routes with competitive pay. Most deliveries are weekday lunch hours with advance scheduling, providing consistent income.
otherRequirements: Clean driving record (no accidents or more than 2 tickets in past 3 years). Dress code: dress pants, collared shirt, closed-toe shoes. Customer service focused.

name: Picnic
description: Picnic provides office and catering delivery with guaranteed pay per shift. Pre-planned routes with flexible scheduling, primarily weekday lunch hours.
otherRequirements: Ability to lift moderate weight for catering orders. Professional appearance.

name: Foodja
description: Foodja delivers corporate lunch catering orders during weekday lunch hours. Earn $40-60/hour for 1-2 hour shifts with flexible scheduling and $250 fast start bonus.
equipmentNeeded: large trunk space for catering orders
otherRequirements: Professional appearance required. Orientation required after application. Most deliveries Mon-Fri 10:30am-12:30pm.

name: Grubhub
description: Grubhub is a leading food delivery platform offering flexible scheduling with competitive pay plus 100% of tips. Deliver by car, bike, or motorcycle in most U.S. cities.
otherRequirements: 21+ in Las Vegas. 21+ for alcohol deliveries. 1-2 years driving experience depending on age. Bike delivery available in select urban markets.
keyFeatures: Food delivery with higher tip-to-base pay ratio (2:1 average).
userFeedback: Pros: Higher tip-to-base pay ratio (2:1). Cons: Lower order volume compared to competitors.

name: Shipt
description: Shipt is a Target-owned grocery delivery service. Shop and deliver groceries with flexible scheduling and earn $16-27/hour plus 100% of tips.
otherRequirements: 21+ for alcohol delivery. 1 year driving experience required. Virtual interview required during application. Knowledge of grocery produce selection helpful.
instantPayMethod: Shipt Instant Pay after completing orders
keyFeatures: Target-owned shopping app; shop and deliver.
userFeedback: Pros: High peak holiday earnings. Cons: High variability by location.

name: Amazon Flex
description: Amazon Flex allows you to deliver Amazon packages on your own schedule. Pick delivery blocks of 2-4 hours and earn $18-35/hour with weekly payouts.
otherRequirements: Valid SSN required. Vehicle must be 1990 or newer. For standard routes: no 2-door cars or open-bed trucks. Prime Now/Fresh orders may allow smaller vehicles. Amazon provides supplemental commercial insurance during active delivery blocks.
keyFeatures: Pre-booking blocks; guaranteed earnings visibility before committing.
userFeedback: Pros: Earnings transparency. Cons: High competition makes it difficult to secure blocks.

name: Gopuff
description: Gopuff delivers everyday essentials from micro-fulfillment centers in under 30 minutes. Work scheduled shifts with guaranteed hourly minimum plus commission per order and 100% of tips.
otherRequirements: Must pass pre-paid regulated product delivery course for alcohol/tobacco where applicable. Vehicle insurance and registration must be in your name.
instantPayMethod: Instant Cash Out ($1.99 fee, $5,000 daily limit)

name: Uber
description: Uber is the world's leading rideshare platform. Drive on your own schedule, earn competitive pay plus tips, and cash out instantly up to 5 times daily.
otherRequirements: At least 1 year licensed driving in US (3 years if under 25). Vehicle must be 10-15 years old or newer, 4 doors, no salvage title. Pass vehicle inspection at approved location.
instantPayMethod: Instant Pay to debit card, up to 5x/day
keyFeatures: Upfront fares; Uber Pro Card (cash back on gas); toggle between transport and Uber Eats; Instant Pay up to 6x daily for $0.85 fee.
userFeedback: Variable; High peak earnings but concerns over vehicle maintenance, depreciation, and declining pay rates.

name: Lyft
description: Lyft is a major rideshare platform offering flexible earning opportunities. Drive passengers in your area, set your own schedule, and get paid weekly with instant payout options.
otherRequirements: Minimum age is 19 in NYC. At least 1 year licensed driving experience (3 years if under 25). Vehicle must be no older than 15 years. No salvage/rebuilt titles. Vehicle inspection required in many locations.
instantPayMethod: Express Pay or Lyft Direct debit card (free)
instantPayFee: free with Lyft Direct, small fee with Express Pay
keyFeatures: Turbo earnings (10-40% more); Ride Challenges; Bonus Zones; Express Drive (car rental); Express Pay daily for fee; Lyft Direct instant pay.
userFeedback: Positive for bonus opportunities; keep 100% of tips; earnings vary heavily by location and timing.

name: Roadie
description: Roadie (owned by UPS) delivers everything from small packages to furniture. Choose your own gigs, work flexible hours, and earn more for larger deliveries. Available nationwide in all 50 states.
otherRequirements: No vehicle age restrictions. Basic tools like dolly or straps helpful for large items. Must have SSN for background check.
instantPayMethod: Instant Pay (requires 5+ completed gigs, 7+ days active)
keyFeatures: Owned by UPS; map-based offer selection; diverse items (luggage to furniture).
userFeedback: Pros: Visual map for jobs. Cons: High mileage required for low-paying deliveries (e.g., CVS).

name: TaskRabbit
description: TaskRabbit connects skilled Taskers with people who need help with everyday tasks like furniture assembly, cleaning, moving, handyman work, and more. Set your own rates and schedule.
otherRequirements: Must have valid SSN. $25 non-refundable registration fee for background check. Vehicle not required for all tasks. Work authorization in US required.

name: Cornershop by Uber
description: Cornershop (owned by Uber) provides grocery shopping and delivery services. Earn $20-24/hour with no commission deductions, plus tips and bonuses.
equipmentNeeded: ability to lift and carry grocery bags
otherRequirements: Legally eligible to work. No minimum order or cashout requirement. Direct deposit payments.

name: Wag!
description: Wag! connects dog walkers with pet owners for on-demand and scheduled dog walking services. Set your own schedule and earn $15-40/hour plus tips.
otherRequirements: $25-65 non-refundable background check fee. Optional Pro membership $149 for faster approval. 5 endorsements recommended. Keep 60% of listed price, Wag takes 40% commission.

name: Handy
description: Handy (Angi Services) connects home cleaning and handyman professionals with customers. Flexible schedule, earn up to $22/hour or $1,000/week depending on jobs taken.
otherRequirements: Must have paid experience in services offered. Proof of experience and any required licenses needed. Independent contractor. 100% flexible schedule - claim only jobs you want.

name: GoShare
description: GoShare offers delivery and moving services with your own vehicle. Earn based on vehicle size: cars $45/hr, pickup trucks $70/hr, cargo vans $105/hr, box trucks $168/hr.
otherRequirements: Vehicle must pass inspection. No salvage titles. Checking account for direct deposit. English proficiency required. Helpers (no vehicle) can earn $40/hr.
keyFeatures: Load board notifications; proof of delivery tools; healthcare discounts; last mile delivery. Earnings depend on vehicle type.
userFeedback: 4.7 out of 5 (12K ratings); High earnings for large vehicles; some reports of project requests not appearing; requires DOT number for sign-up.

name: Caviar
description: Premium food delivery platform focused on high-end and Michelin-rated restaurants. Originally founded in 2012, acquired by Square, then sold to DoorDash in 2019 for $410 million. Caviar still exists as a separate app but all deliveries are now fulfilled by DoorDash drivers.
redirectMessage: Caviar no longer hires its own drivers. To deliver Caviar orders, sign up as a DoorDash Dasher - you will automatically receive both DoorDash and Caviar orders.

name: Favor
description: Favor is a Texas-only delivery platform offering flexible delivery by car, bike, or scooter. Earn $12-20/hour including 100% of tips (required on every order) with weekly payouts.
equipmentNeeded: valid driver's license if using car
otherRequirements: Texas only. Customer tip required on each order. Orientation/training at Runner Clubhouse. Pay for own gas and supplies.

name: Dumpling
description: Dumpling lets you start your own grocery delivery business. Set your own rates, keep 100% of tips, and build your own client base. Earn $35-50 per order as an independent business owner.
otherRequirements: $19.99 one-time setup fee + $9/month subscription. 5-8% platform fee paid by clients, 2.7-2.9% processing fee. You run your own business and set your own pricing.

name: Rover
description: Rover connects pet sitters and dog walkers with pet owners for boarding, sitting, and walking services. Set your own rates and schedule, earn $15-50/hour plus tips.
otherRequirements: $35-49 background check fee. Rover takes 20% commission. No vehicle required unless offering pet transportation. Educational videos and safety quiz required. Meet-and-greets recommended.

name: Dolly
description: Dolly offers moving and delivery services with two roles: Helpers (with truck/van, $50-90/hr) and Hands (muscle only, $35-60/hr). Keep 100% of tips, paid twice weekly via PayPal.
otherRequirements: Helpers must be 21+. Hands (no vehicle) must be 18+. Vehicle must be 2000 or newer. Possible waitlist in some cities. Top performers can make $2,000/week with box truck.
keyFeatures: Helper marketplace; PayPal payouts twice weekly; retailer enablement via branded landing pages/QR codes; scheduled and same-day delivery; role differentiation (hands/helpers).
userFeedback: Explicit helper earnings claims; clear pay method and cadence; limited public disclosure about worker eligibility/screening.

name: Drizly
description: Drizly was the largest online alcohol delivery marketplace in North America. Acquired by Uber in 2021 for $1.1 billion, it was permanently shut down in March 2024. Alcohol delivery is now available through Uber Eats.
redirectMessage: Drizly permanently shut down in March 2024. Uber now handles alcohol delivery through Uber Eats in 35 U.S. states.

name: Thumbtack
description: Thumbtack connects service professionals with customers for home services, events, wellness, and more. Set your own rates, keep 100% of payments, and pay per lead instead of commission.
otherRequirements: Must comply with local licensing/insurance for your profession. No signup or annual fees. Pay per lead model - you pay Thumbtack for customer contacts. Set your own service area and rates.

name: Bellhop
description: Bellhop is a moving services platform for drivers with 16-26ft box trucks. Earn $15-21/hour as a 'no-touch freight' driver - you transport while movers handle the lifting.
otherRequirements: Must be registered with DOT and hold MC number for interstate work. No heavy lifting - movers handle that. Set your own schedule via app. Weekly pay.

name: Postmates
description: One of the original on-demand delivery platforms, founded in 2011 in San Francisco. Acquired by Uber for $2.65 billion in 2020. The driver app was permanently shut down in August 2021. All deliveries are now handled through Uber Eats.
redirectMessage: Postmates permanently shut down its driver app in August 2021 after being acquired by Uber. All deliveries are now handled through Uber Eats.

name: Spark Driver
description: Spark Driver delivers Walmart orders including groceries and packages. Earn $15-20+ per delivery with 100% of tips. Set your own schedule and see earnings before accepting orders.
equipmentNeeded: smartphone (iOS or Android) with GPS and camera
ability to lift up to 60 lbs
otherRequirements: Valid Social Security number. Vehicle must be insured in your name with minimum state-required insurance. No vehicle age restrictions. Motorcycles, scooters, and bicycles not accepted. Zones may have waitlist.

name: Veho
description: Veho is a last-mile package delivery platform delivering for major retailers. Pick routes in advance, earn $20-26/hour plus 100% of tips. Requires larger vehicle (SUV, minivan, or cargo van).
equipmentNeeded: large sedan or bigger (SUVs, minivans, cargo vans)
pickup trucks must have hard bed cover
otherRequirements: Small sedans (Honda Civic, Nissan Sentra) do NOT qualify. All packages for route must fit securely in vehicle. Routes posted in advance (not on-demand). High ratings and professionalism expected. Provide delivery completion photos.

name: Workwhile
description: Workwhile connects workers with flexible warehouse, picking, packing, and general labor shifts. Get paid the next day after your shift with no resume required. Both W-2 and 1099 positions available.
equipmentNeeded: some roles may require certifications (forklift, food handler, etc.)
otherRequirements: Strict three-strike policy for no-shows. Both W-2 and 1099 roles available. No resume required. Must verify identity and eligibility to work in US. Pay rates posted upfront per shift.

name: Curri
description: Curri specializes in delivering construction materials and supplies from hardware stores to job sites. Earn $10-30/hour with same-day or next-day pay. Larger vehicles (pickup trucks, vans, box trucks) earn significantly more.
equipmentNeeded: vehicle cargo area must be clear for loading
otherRequirements: Valid SSN, TIN, or EIN required. Must pass criminal and MVR background check (completed within 48 hours). Vehicle must be clean and in good condition. Commercial insurance required for larger vehicles. Larger vehicles qualify for higher-paying jobs. May be waitlisted until demand rises in your area.
keyFeatures: Bidding system for carriers; upfront pay transparency; route navigation; fuel discount program access. Instant Pay available (1% fee).
userFeedback: 3.0 out of 5; Favored by owners of larger vehicles; better pay than food delivery; noted long approval wait times and unhelpful support.

name: Frayt
description: Frayt is an on-demand delivery platform for same-day local deliveries. Earn $20-30/hour plus tips with pay within 48 hours. Accepts cars, SUVs, pickups, vans, and box trucks.
equipmentNeeded: ability to lift up to 50 lbs
otherRequirements: Valid driver's license and proof of personal auto insurance required. Clean driving record. Good communication skills. Nonrefundable application fee may apply. Only hiring in select markets - check app for availability in your zip code.
keyFeatures: Preferred Driver Program; Branch app integration; stacked offers (up to 3); 24/7 support; box truck options. Daily payouts available.
userFeedback: 4.3 to 4.8 out of 5; Positive for local runs and communication; frustration over $40 non-refundable application fee and glitchy app.

name: Metrobi
description: Metrobi specializes in route-based local deliveries for businesses like restaurants, bakeries, and grocery stores. Earn up to $1,200/week with weekly direct deposit. Requires larger vehicles (SUV, minivan, or van).
equipmentNeeded: Ability to carry items up to 40 lbs
otherRequirements: Vehicle must be clean and in good working condition. Sedans and pickup trucks are NOT eligible. Rental vehicles are not allowed. Weekly pay via direct deposit through Stripe. Must connect bank account to receive payment.
keyFeatures: Explicit vehicle exclusions (no sedans or pickup trucks); SUVs/vans/reefer vans/box trucks only; market waitlists; Stripe-linked payouts; delivery management software for businesses ($0 first year).
userFeedback: Unusually clear vehicle eligibility; public SaaS pricing component; payout speed described as Stripe-based/variable.

name: Dispatch
description: Dispatch connects independent drivers with same-day delivery jobs from retailers and businesses. Operating in 50+ cities nationwide with many active openings. Earn $75-125/day with instant pay or weekly payouts. Higher age and experience requirements ensure professional service.
equipmentNeeded: Dolly, liftgate, racks earn enhanced pay
otherRequirements: Minimum 2 years licensed driving in US/Canada. $40 background check fee. No felonies in 10 years, no DUI/DWI in 5 years, max 3 minor violations in 3 years. Commercial insurance preferred. Vehicle must have proof of ownership. Must complete Dispatch training. Accept at least 1 order every 180 days to keep account active. Vehicle capacity: cars (240 lbs), mid-size (500 lbs), pickups (1,000 lbs), cargo vans (3,500 lbs), box trucks up to 26ft (12,500 lbs).

USA.status: Available nationwide - actively hiring in 50+ cities

name: Courial
description: Courial is a concierge-style delivery platform offering competitive pay and professional service. Earn $18-25/hour with flexible vehicle options including cars, bikes, scooters, or on foot. Known for supporting EV drivers.
otherRequirements: 18+ for bike/foot/scooter delivery, 21+ for vehicle delivery. Resume and cover letter required for application. Apply via email to jobs@courial.com. Vehicle can be owned, leased, or rented. Well-maintained vehicles required. Known for supporting electric vehicle drivers with additional benefits.

name: Airspace
description: Time-critical courier platform specializing in urgent shipments like organ transplants, aircraft parts, and semiconductors. Drivers (called Commanders) handle local and airport pickups/dropoffs nationwide with 24/7 dispatch and flexible scheduling.

name: American Expediting
description: American Expediting is a medical and specialized courier service operating nationwide with 50+ locations in the U.S. and Canada. Drivers handle time-sensitive deliveries including medical specimens, legal documents, and other critical materials. The platform offers TSA, HIPAA, and Bloodborne Pathogens certification access, fuel and insurance discounts, and digital management via Openforce.
keyFeatures: TSA, HIPAA, and Bloodborne Pathogens certification access; fuel and insurance discounts; digital management via Openforce.
userFeedback: 2.9 out of 5 (Indeed); Professional environment with high reliability expectations; noted significant insurance (100/300) and upfront fees.

name: Field Agent
description: Field Agent is a retail audit and mystery shopping platform where gig workers complete in-store tasks like photo audits, price checks, and product displays. No car is required - tasks are accessible via walking or transit. Earn $3 to $20+ per task with an equivalent hourly rate of $28-$30/hr.
keyFeatures: In-store tasks; photo audits; mystery shopping; no car required.
userFeedback: Pros: Accessible via walking/transit. Cons: Highly competitive; jobs claimed in seconds.

name: Hyer
description: Hyer is an on-demand staffing platform focused on retail merchandising, admin tasks, and general labor. Workers pick up hourly shifts with in-app status updates, a rating system, and Hyer Profiles. Background check costs are covered via earnings. Active in 27 states with heavy concentration in the Midwest.
keyFeatures: In-app status updates; rating system; Hyer Profiles; messaging system; background check cost covered via earnings.
userFeedback: 4.7 out of 5 (App Store); Good for retail flexibility; noted long background check times and limited assignments in some areas.

name: Instawork
description: Instawork is a staffing platform for general labor and hospitality shifts offering a hybrid 1099 and W-2 model. Workers get transparent hourly rates, full 8-hour blocks, and a Reliability score tracking system. Active in 40+ major U.S. markets. Instapay lets you access 60% of earnings within 1 hour for a 5% fee.
keyFeatures: Hybrid 1099 and W-2 model; Reliability score tracking; rigorous vetting; full 8-hour blocks; Instapay (60% of earnings in 1 hour for 5% fee).
userFeedback: Highly positive; perceived as professional and reliable; Instapay requires 2 completed shifts and a 7-day wait.

name: Observa
description: Observa is a retail audit platform where gig workers earn $10-$25 per gig completing photo audits, merchandising checks, and product displays in stores. Jobs can be reserved for up to 2 hours and payment is sent instantly via PayPal after approval.
keyFeatures: Photo audits; merchandising; 2-hour job reservations; PayPal instant payment.
userFeedback: Pros: High pay per gig relative to time. Cons: Lower job volume.

name: Poplin
description: Poplin (formerly Laundry Pros) is a specialty home services platform where workers wash, dry, and fold laundry from home. Earn $0.75-$1.50 per pound plus tips, with top earners making up to $6,000/month. Features a ranking system (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and in-app messaging. Active in 500+ cities across the U.S. and Canada.
keyFeatures: Ranking system (Bronze/Silver/Gold); garment protection plan; detergent choice; in-app messaging; work from home.
userFeedback: 3.3 to 4.4 out of 5; Great for work-from-home roles; community feel; some complaints about app glitches and strict penalties.

name: Qwick
description: Qwick is a hospitality staffing platform connecting workers with shifts at restaurants, hotels, catering companies, and event venues. Offers both 1099 and W-2 options with competitive market-based hourly rates. Features an AI matching assistant (Mara) and Stripe-powered payments. Active in 40+ major U.S. cities.
keyFeatures: 1099 and W-2 options; AI matching assistant (Mara); 1:1 orientation; Stripe-powered payments; Instant Pay (30 mins for 3% fee).
userFeedback: Very high ratings; respected for high-quality shifts and fast pay; strict no-show policy leads to permanent suspension.

name: shiftNOW
description: shiftNOW is a hospitality and event staffing platform operating primarily in the Southeast U.S. Workers earn $19-$20/hr on most jobs across 40+ role types. Features a comprehensive profile with video, performance metrics, and Stripe-powered transfers. Pay within 48 hours or Instant Pay (1 hour for 3% fee).
keyFeatures: Comprehensive Shifter profile with video; performance metrics; 40+ role types; Stripe-powered transfers; Instant Pay (1 hour for 3% fee).
userFeedback: 3.5 to 4.6 out of 5; Highly positive for flexibility and quality venues; some reports of technical registration issues.

name: Better Trucks
description: Better Trucks is a regional last-mile parcel carrier with a driver-facing shift workflow offering route-based delivery work. Drivers earn an estimated $75-$175+ per route. The platform supports next-day, two-day, and same-day service and uses route optimization tooling. Coverage spans the Midwest with expansion into other regions.
keyFeatures: Route-based shift work; next-day/two-day/same-day service; route optimization; shipper integrations including ShipStation.
userFeedback: Clear regional coverage messaging; driver-facing entry point; worker payout cadence partially documented.

name: Bring It Now
description: Bring It Now is an on-demand local hauling, moving, and delivery app that connects customers with Delivery Pros using larger vehicles. Earnings range from $22-$69/hour depending on vehicle type, plus tips. Roles available for both Driver Pros and helpers.
keyFeatures: Vehicle-class earnings tiers; Driver Pro and helper roles; customers tips retained by workers; two-person deliveries for heavy items.
userFeedback: Explicit vehicle class requirements and earning range claims; cities served and payout cadence not fully enumerated.

name: Bungii
description: Bungii is a big-and-bulky last-mile delivery network for retail, omnichannel fulfillment, and reverse logistics. Drivers are paid twice weekly (Tuesday/Friday) with an option for same-day pay for a fee. Enterprise partners include FloorFound and Big Lots.
keyFeatures: Twice weekly pay (Tue/Fri); optional same-day pay for fee; big-and-bulky retail delivery; enterprise case studies; API integration capability.
userFeedback: Strong enterprise documentation and case studies; explicit pay cadence; vehicle specifics less detailed than some competitors.

name: CitizenShipper
description: CitizenShipper is a marketplace for pet transport and long-distance specialty shipping. Transporters bid on jobs and get paid via Stripe Connect after delivery confirmation, with settlement in 2-5 business days. Background checks include criminal and MVR screening via Checkr.
keyFeatures: Bid/quote marketplace; Stripe Connect payouts (2-5 day settlement); Checkr background screening; pet and specialty transport focus; escrow-like payment mediation.
userFeedback: Clear payout release policy; explicit screening disclosures; vehicle requirements vary by shipment type.

name: Draiver
description: Draiver is a vehicle movement platform where insured drivers move cars at scale for dealerships and fleets. Weekly payouts every Friday with clear driver eligibility requirements including license, background check, and driving record review.
keyFeatures: Vehicle movement for dealerships/fleets; Friday weekly payouts; clear eligibility checklist; trip-based work; no personal vehicle needed.
userFeedback: Clear pay calendar and eligibility criteria; earnings variability and trip availability constraints acknowledged.

name: Dropoff
description: Dropoff is a same-day courier service with a strong healthcare focus. Couriers are HIPAA and bloodborne pathogen certified for medical deliveries. The platform offers API integrations for businesses and operates in 58+ cities with per-delivery pay.
keyFeatures: HIPAA and bloodborne pathogen certified drivers; healthcare delivery specialization; API integrations; 58+ cities; per-delivery pay; after-hours/weekend surcharge for businesses.
userFeedback: Strong healthcare compliance posture; API positioning; courier payout cadence less clearly documented.

name: Fetch Package
description: Fetch Package is an apartment package delivery partner program. Delivery Partners earn $18-$25/hour estimated via pre-scheduled blocks, picking up batches of packages and delivering to apartment residents. Requires background check and ability to carry up to 70 lbs.
keyFeatures: Block scheduling model; apartment community package delivery; batch pickup and drop-off; background checks required; must carry up to 70 lbs.
userFeedback: Explicit earning range and physical requirements; payout schedule and city coverage not fully enumerated.

name: Gopher Go
description: Gopher Go is a local services marketplace where Gophers complete delivery, errand, and handyman requests. Payouts via Stripe with instant payout available after 10 completed requests. Pro tiers unlock faster payout options. Workers can counter-offer on jobs.
keyFeatures: Stripe payouts; instant payout after 10 completed requests; Pro tiers for faster payouts; counter-offer on jobs; broad local services scope.
userFeedback: Highly explicit payout timing and instant payout criteria; vehicle requirements vary by request type.

name: iSecretShop
description: iSecretShop is a mystery shopping platform and job aggregator connecting shoppers with multiple mystery shopping providers (MSPs). The platform does not pay shoppers directly — payment comes from individual MSPs. Free to register with mobile-first assignment workflows including geo-tags, time stamps, and photo capture.
keyFeatures: Job aggregator for multiple MSPs; mobile-first with geo-tags and photo capture; free registration; platform does not pay directly — MSPs handle payment.
userFeedback: Clear payment responsibility statement; earnings and scheduling vary entirely by MSP and assignment.

name: JackRabbit
description: JackRabbit is a catering delivery network with unusually explicit pay policy details including same-day payout timing, minimum pay rules for catering orders, and guaranteed tips. Requires XXL insulated catering bags for larger deliveries.
keyFeatures: Same-day payout; minimum pay floor for catering orders; guaranteed tips; XXL catering bag requirement for large orders; catering delivery focus.
userFeedback: Very directory-friendly payout disclosure; clear equipment guidance; geographic coverage not fully enumerated.

name: Lugg
description: Lugg is a moving and large-item delivery app with driver and helper roles. Claims same-day pay for completed jobs. Also partners with retailers for same-day big-and-bulky delivery of purchased items. Two-person moving crews handle furniture and large items.
keyFeatures: Same-day pay; driver and helper roles; two-person moving crews; retailer big-and-bulky delivery partnerships; flexible scheduling.
userFeedback: Simple value proposition; quick-pay positioning; city coverage not fully enumerated.

name: Medzoomer
description: Medzoomer is an on-demand prescription delivery platform connecting pharmacies with HIPAA-certified couriers. Drivers must complete training and become HIPAA certified before first deliveries. Background-checked courier network handles pharmacy-to-patient medication delivery.
keyFeatures: HIPAA certification required for couriers; pharmacy-to-patient delivery; courier training program; background-checked network; pharmacy integration.
userFeedback: Explicit HIPAA training posture; clear courier onboarding steps; earnings and payout schedules not clearly published.

name: PICKUP
description: PICKUP is a big-and-bulky retail delivery program for independent Delivery Pros. Focuses on new items only (no junk hauling). Minimum $25 per run, average ~$45 per run, with potential hourly equivalents up to $50/hr. Next-business-day payouts. Requires pickup truck or van.
keyFeatures: New items only (no junk); minimum $25/run; average $45/run; next-business-day payouts; no sign-up fees; pickup truck or van required.
userFeedback: Strong payout clarity; explicit vehicle requirements; city availability not fully enumerated.

name: Pills2Me
description: Pills2Me is a prescription delivery service where drivers pick up medications from pharmacies and deliver to patients. Requires HIPAA training, DMV checks, and background checks. Advertises instant cashout for completed deliveries.
keyFeatures: Instant cashout; HIPAA training required; DMV and background checks; prescription pickup and delivery; community health focus.
userFeedback: Explicit instant cashout claim; clear screening steps; cities served and base pay ranges not fully specified.

name: RedWagon Delivers
description: RedWagon Delivers is a delivery network with a strong catering focus plus additional delivery categories. Driver pay is currently weekly with same-day pay coming soon. Simple onboarding process for catering delivery drivers.
keyFeatures: Catering delivery focus; weekly pay (same-day pay coming soon); multiple delivery categories; simple onboarding.
userFeedback: Clear pay cadence statement; simple onboarding; city coverage and vehicle requirements not fully enumerated.

name: Relay Delivery
description: Relay Delivery is a courier platform offering shift-based work with earnings that include hourly pay, bonuses, and 100% of tips. Couriers can sign up for car or bike mode. Focused on local food and package delivery in select markets.
keyFeatures: Shift-based scheduling; hourly pay + bonuses + 100% tips; car or bike modes; local delivery focus.
userFeedback: Clear earnings framing and tip policy; payout cadence and city coverage not fully specified.

name: SeimDei
description: SeimDei is a catering delivery network operating in markets including Philadelphia, Jersey City, Atlanta and surrounding areas. Requires at least two insulated catering bags. Driver screening process and application flow shows available markets.
keyFeatures: Catering delivery specialization; requires 2+ insulated catering bags; example markets shown in application flow; driver screening.
userFeedback: Clear equipment requirements and market visibility; payout cadence and earnings not publicly documented.

name: Trado
description: Trado is a delivery driver marketplace where drivers keep 90% of the fare and are paid within 48 hours. Broad vehicle eligibility with any make, model, or year accepted. No DOT or commercial license needed for most deliveries.
keyFeatures: Keep 90% of fare; 48-hour payout; any vehicle make/model/year; no DOT or commercial license needed; in-app job acceptance/rejection.
userFeedback: Explicit payout timing and driver-share claim; broad vehicle eligibility; aggressive earnings claims not independently verified.

name: Wonolo
description: Wonolo is an always-on staffing marketplace for on-demand, ongoing, and temp-to-perm frontline hourly labor. Features a public REST API with webhooks for business integrations and published hiring fee schedules. Workers find shifts across warehouse, retail, and event roles.
keyFeatures: On-demand and temp-to-perm staffing; REST API with webhooks; published hiring fee schedule; G2 reviewed; warehouse/retail/event shifts.
userFeedback: Strong integration story; contract terms provide concrete figures; worker payout cadence not clearly published.

name: BestMark
description: BestMark is one of the largest mystery shopping companies in North America. Shoppers complete store, restaurant, and service evaluations and submit detailed reports. Assignments pay $10–$50 per shop depending on complexity, and some include reimbursement for purchases. A vehicle is sometimes required depending on the assignment location.
keyFeatures: Store and restaurant evaluations; purchase reimbursement on some shops; one of the largest mystery shopping companies in North America.
userFeedback: Pros: Wide variety of assignments. Cons: Reports can be detailed and time-consuming.

name: Market Force Information
description: Market Force Information is a customer experience management company that hires mystery shoppers to evaluate restaurants, retail stores, and service businesses. Shoppers complete assignments, submit reports, and earn $10–$40 per shop. Some assignments include meal or purchase reimbursements. A vehicle is sometimes required depending on location.
keyFeatures: Restaurant and retail mystery shopping; meal and purchase reimbursements on select assignments; established CX management company.
userFeedback: Pros: Reputable company with consistent assignments. Cons: Pay per shop can be low for time spent.

name: ProductTube
description: ProductTube is a market research platform where users earn money by recording short video reviews of products they already own or use. Tasks pay $5–$35 depending on complexity and product category. No vehicle or special equipment is needed beyond a smartphone with a camera. A flexible way to earn from home on your own schedule.
keyFeatures: Video product reviews; work from home; no vehicle required; flexible schedule.
userFeedback: Pros: Easy to do from home. Cons: Task availability can be limited.

name: AmeriShip Parcel Delivery
description: AmeriShip Parcel Delivery is a medical and parcel courier service that offers contract delivery routes. Drivers handle medical specimens, lab supplies, and general parcels on assigned routes. Typical weekly earnings range from $500–$1,500 depending on route length and volume. A reliable vehicle is required. A solid option for drivers seeking consistent, structured route-based income.
keyFeatures: Contract delivery routes; medical and parcel courier; $500–$1,500/week potential; structured scheduling.
userFeedback: Pros: Consistent route-based income. Cons: Requires reliable vehicle and commitment to scheduled routes.

name: Lab Logistics
description: Lab Logistics specializes in laboratory specimen transport and medical courier services. Drivers pick up and deliver lab samples, medical records, and supplies between healthcare facilities on scheduled or on-call routes. Pay ranges from $18–$35 per hour depending on route and contract type. A vehicle and clean driving record are required.
keyFeatures: Lab specimen transport; medical courier; hourly and contract pay options; healthcare facility routes.
userFeedback: Pros: Steady medical courier work. Cons: Requires commitment to scheduled routes and healthcare compliance.

name: Medical Couriers Inc
description: Medical Couriers Inc provides route-based medical delivery services including lab specimens, pharmaceuticals, and medical supplies. Drivers operate on assigned routes between hospitals, clinics, and laboratories. Pay ranges from $20–$40 per hour depending on route complexity and region. A reliable vehicle and clean background are required.
keyFeatures: Route-based medical deliveries; lab specimens and pharmaceuticals; hospital and clinic routes; $20–$40/hr.
userFeedback: Pros: Higher pay than standard delivery. Cons: Strict scheduling and compliance requirements.

name: SwiftScale Marketing Pros
description: SwiftScale Marketing Pros hires petition circulators and field canvassers for political and advocacy campaigns. Workers earn $10–$25 per signature collected, making it a high-earning opportunity for outgoing individuals. No vehicle is required — work is done on foot in public spaces. Some campaigns offer instant or same-day payout.
keyFeatures: Petition circulating; per-signature pay ($10–$25); no vehicle required; field canvassing for campaigns.
userFeedback: Pros: High earning potential for outgoing individuals. Cons: Seasonal and campaign-dependent availability.
